semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Taiwan Busway Co., Ltd. provides power distribution solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing facilities, particularly in high-tech environments.
summary: Taiwan Busway Co., Ltd. specializes in the design and production of advanced busway systems and power distribution solutions, particularly for high-tech fabs and data centers. Their products enhance the reliability and safety of electrical systems, catering to the unique needs of IT and mission-critical environments.

Continuous Plug-in Technology for data centers
EZ-power panel for advanced power distribution

regional_presence.Taiwan: Taiwan Busway Co., Ltd. is based in Taiwan and has over eighteen years of experience in designing and manufacturing power distribution systems.
